### Bio:

I am a second-year MS student in the Department of Biostatistics at UCLA, where I work with Dr. Brunilda Balliu and Dr. Thomas Belin. I previously completed my undergraduate studies in Public Health and Data Science at UC Berkeley. My research focuses on developing scalable statistical methods for analyzing multi-omic data, with an interest in modeling dynamic patterns of gene regulation during cellular differentiation and their role in complex disease. In my spare time, I enjoy playing tennis, exploring the city, and spending time with my dog, Louie.
